    p2p_op_list.append(torch.distributed.P2POp(torch.distributed.isend, send_tensor, 0))

output_size = (6, 6)
kernel_size = (3, 3)
dilation = (1, 1)
padding = (1, 1)
stride = (2, 2)

N, C = 2, 3
L = ((output_size[0] + 2 * padding[0] - dilation[0] * (kernel_size[0] - 1) - 1) // stride[0] + 1) * \
    ((output_size[1] + 2 * padding[1] - dilation[1] * (kernel_size[1] - 1) - 1) // stride[1] + 1)
input_tensor = torch.randn(N, C * kernel_size[0] * kernel_size[1], L)

fold_layer = nn.Fold(output_size=output_size, kernel_size=kernel_size, dilation=dilation, padding=padding, stride=stride)
output = fold_layer(input_tensor)
constraints: 输入张量形状必须为(N, C × ∏(kernel_size), L)，其中N为批量维度，C为通道数，L为滑动块总数。output_size、kernel_size、padding、dilation、stride的维度必须一致，且满足公式：L = ∏_d ⌊(output_size[d] + 2 × padding[d] - dilation[d] × (kernel_size[d] - 1) - 1) / stride[d] + 1⌋，其中d遍历所有空间维度。padding、dilation、stride的默认值分别为0、1、1，且必须为非负整数或整数元组。
